title: Targeted Engagement
description: Essential Criteria: The response directly addresses the specific claim identified in opponent_claim_targeted, engaging with the warrant or evidence rather than pivoting to a different point.

title: Refutation Method
description: Essential Criteria: The rebuttal uses at least one explicit method of refutation, like contesting the evidence, undercutting the warrant, turning the argument, or showing the impact does not follow.

title: No Concession by Silence
description: Important Criteria: The response does not leave major opponent arguments entirely unaddressed when those arguments were the stated target of this turn.

title: Responsive Depth
description: Important Criteria: The rebuttal goes beyond simply asserting the opponent is wrong and explains specifically what is incorrect, incomplete, or inapplicable about the targeted claim.

title: Turn Attempt
description: Optional Criteria: Where applicable, the response attempts to show that the opponent's own argument actually supports the affirmative/negative position, rather than only minimizing its impact.

title: Dropped Argument
description: Pitfall Criteria: Does not completely ignore a major opposing argument that the turn_id position and opponent_claim_targeted field indicate should have been addressed.

title: Assertion-Only Rebuttal
description: Pitfall Criteria: Does not rebut by simply reasserting the original position more forcefully without engaging with the opponent's specific warrant.
